# model-catalog

> Versioned, validated catalog of LLM models with context window, Decimal prices and capabilities, point-in-time lookups and filter queries over caller-supplied data Python package `trysac-model-catalog`, import name `model_catalog`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
